summary: OpenAI published a case study describing how it worked with Thrive and Crete to build a self-improving tax-filing agent using Codex.

mechanisms.reason: The case study describes an agent automating tax filing workflows that were previously done via seat-based software or manual work.
mechanisms.quote: See how OpenAI, Thrive, and Crete built a self-improving tax agent with Codex, automating filings, improving accuracy, and accelerating workflows.
